status: RATIFIED 2026-06-24 (M0 scaffold merged); contract 2.0 as of 2026-08-09

survey.what_is_it: library/tooling — grounded-retrieval tools (MCP server + CLI) an agent calls: ground or abstain, never invent. Cairn makes no model calls on the deciding path.

architecture_rung.earned_by: A single primary agent on main. The evidence path is pure deterministic functions with a CI-blocking oracle, so a verifier rung would duplicate what the gate already does. Read-only research swarms have been spawned twice (OCR failure modes, attestation landscape) as bounded one-off investigations whose findings went to human triage — that is a tool used, not a rung earned.

survey.domain_core_llm_must_not_own: Everything on the evidence path: retrieval, span resolution and hash verification, the support floor, constraint coverage, the audit chain, and the five outcome classes. A model may draft prose and judge entailment OFFLINE at Layer-E; it never decides whether a citation is real or whether evidence suffices. Human adjudication is likewise machine-unwritable (D47/D50).

oracle_shape.goldens: golden_seed.json (20 items, Apple FY2024 10-K) and golden_patent.json (25 items, US5447630A) — both ratified and frozen with a manifest hash; append-only. golden_patent2.json is a separability PROBE, explicitly not an oracle.
oracle_shape.ci: pytest -m layer0 — deterministic, no model calls, blocking on every push. Layer-E is behavioural, billed, periodic, and never a gate.

consumes: autonomous (doctrine, harness kit, MCP security-hardening brief)
provides: an MCP tool surface (6 tools, stdio) for grounded retrieval over a hashed corpus

invariants.I1: span-level provenance — every claim points to a real span
invariants.I4: read/write asymmetry — the audit log is the only writable surface
invariants.I6: deterministic evidence layer — no model on the DECIDING path (contract 2.0, D60)

notes: Phase state lives in ROADMAP.md, not here (Decision 28). Where this manifest and ROADMAP disagree about what is done, ROADMAP wins.
